name: zgeometry_clip_polygon_copy_points_out_rotated_back
description: zGeometry_ClipPolygon::CopyPointsOutRotatedBack copies the clip polygon points to caller-owned output storage and rotates them back from XY clipping space.
known_limits: Binary Ninja renders the inlined rep movsd/movsb point copy as split memcpy-like operations. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46aab0 validates writing clipPolygon->pointCount to the output count, reallocating the caller's point buffer to pointCount * sizeof(zVec3), copying clipPolygon->points, rotating the output with RotateNeg90AroundX, and returning zero.
The native clip-polygon smoke verifies output point count, allocation, copied point data, and rotation back to the original input coordinates.
